name: STI Foods Holdings,Inc.
summary: STI Foods Holdings, Inc. develops and distributes food products with a focus on seafood. Its prepared items include grilled salted mackerel, rice balls with salmon roe, mackerel in olive oil, saury with mushrooms, miso-simmered mackerel and mussels in garlic butter, among others. Dating from 1988, it has its headquarters in Minato, Japan.
